title: Residual-dimension obstructions for null-projected supersymmetric Yang-Mills theories — submission package
description:
Residual-dimension obstructions for null-projected supersymmetric Yang-Mills theories. Hexagon/Overleaf and Annals of Physics submission preparation, version 1.2.0. The reviewed folder Paper_4 package contains the article PDF, a minimal compilable TeX ZIP, AI provenance, Hexagon fields, journal details, an unsent cover letter with editable source, and an author-prepared AI disclosure. All PDFs have no row or margin line numbers. No journal submission or acceptance is claimed.

The paper proves necessary residual-dimension and signature conditions for null-projected supersymmetric Yang-Mills constructions under five explicit axioms. It also gives a separate unitary helicity-span obstruction. It does not assert existence in every allowed signature or a nonperturbative quantum construction.

Verification scope: No general Lean formalisation is claimed. The proof is written in the manuscript; the gamma-matrix calculations are supplementary finite numerical checks.

Original preprint: https://hexagonmath.org/2610.00471v1. Earlier manuscript/source DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23611588. Original attribution and component licences are preserved. Human-understanding and mixed-text declarations record the submitting author's explicit statement on 25 October 2026. The standalone AI declaration is author-prepared, not an official signed publisher form.
